aboutGame.title: What is Heartfall A Tale in Three Lives?
paragraphs: Heartfall A Tale in Three Lives is a free, single-player visual novel RPG developed by Kazehita and inspired by the 3rd Life YouTube series. You wake as Grian on a mysterious island, explore the library, build alliances, and make dialogue choices that steer the story across twelve numbered routes.

The project pairs 400,000+ words of dialogue with 450+ cut-in artworks and 50+ original music tracks. Choices compound across early sessions, route gates lock in a storyline, and 36 Steam achievements map endings that range from quiet gardens to violent finales.

modules.name: Heartfall A Tale in Three Lives Routes and Endings
modules.description: Map Route 0 through Route 11, follow the early gates that open each branch, and see how final-act choices split the story into different endings.

highlights.label: Route 0
highlights.detail: The shared opening spine; two endings split on Martyn's blow and a final decision.

highlights.label: Route 8
highlights.detail: Music is Magic contains five endings, the densest ending run in the game.

highlights.label: Route 10
highlights.detail: Any-fin is Possible trades combat for a fishing loop and three comedic endings.

highlights.label: Route 11
highlights.detail: Wolf in Sheep's Wool hides two stark outcomes behind the statue and volcano prompts.

modules.name: Heartfall A Tale in Three Lives Beginner Guide
modules.description: Start with the shared opening, protect your first save, and learn which early conversations determine your route before the island branches.

highlights.detail: Explore the library first; most route starters unlock through conversations that follow it.
Save at the end of Session 1 in a separate slot before accepting any alliance offer.
Treat Route 0 as the hub and turn down detours until you know which branch you want.
Update to Patch 1.01 before troubleshooting Route 8 and keep multiple saves backed up.

modules.name: Heartfall A Tale in Three Lives Character Guide
modules.description: Meet the playable cast, see where each character anchors a route, and track the alliances that shape Grian's story.

highlights.label: Grian
highlights.detail: Protagonist and player lens; his relationships determine which character routes carry the emotional weight.

highlights.label: Scar
highlights.detail: Central ally in the desert storyline and a major presence in recruitment and flower valley scenes.

highlights.label: Scott
highlights.detail: Alliance builder tied to flower-themed objectives and the flowerhusbands path.

highlights.label: Jimmy
highlights.detail: Paired with Scott in alliance-heavy routes and the cow heist storyline.

highlights.label: Watchers
highlights.detail: Enigmatic late or secret figures whose encoded dialogue rewards unconventional choices.

modules.name: Heartfall A Tale in Three Lives Choices and Decisions
modules.description: Separate route gates from flavor dialogue and see which decisions permanently change alliances, life state, and endings.

highlights.label: S
highlights.detail: Route gates: accepting the cow heist, Jimmy's request, or Impulse's material run commits the run to a new spine.

highlights.label: A
highlights.detail: Life state: taking Martyn's blow changes the Route 0 line and locks scenes for that save.

highlights.label: B
highlights.detail: Final-act choices: the music box and volcano prompts decide which achievement-ending you receive.

highlights.label: C
highlights.detail: Reputation and tone: complaints and small dialogue answers adjust reactions but rarely redirect the route.

modules.name: Heartfall A Tale in Three Lives Walkthrough
modules.description: Follow a clean route workflow from version check and save setup through chapter progression, ending tracking, and spoiler-light cleanup.

highlights.detail: Confirm you are on Patch 1.01, choose your platform, and check that saves are writing correctly.
Create a Route 0 clean save before the first village conversation.
Record every route gate and major alliance prompt in a run log.
Track endings by route, starting with the five-ending Route 8 cluster.
Use throwaway saves for risky prompts, then return to clean checkpoints.

modules.name: Heartfall A Tale in Three Lives Achievements Guide
modules.description: Use the route guide to connect all 36 Steam achievements to their branches, endings, and cleanup saves.

highlights.label: 36 Goals
highlights.detail: Steam lists 36 achievements; route endings and alternate finales account for the completion checklist.

highlights.label: Route 8
highlights.detail: Five endings share one setup, making it the most efficient achievement cluster.

highlights.label: Patch 1.01
highlights.detail: Install the patch before chasing Route 8; it fixes a reported softlock tied to that branch.

highlights.label: Save Slots
highlights.detail: Keep dedicated pre-ending saves so cleanup runs do not overwrite completed routes.

modules.name: Heartfall A Tale in Three Lives System Requirements
modules.description: Check the official Windows, macOS, and Linux specs, install size, and the memory gap between minimum and recommended play.

highlights.label: Windows
highlights.detail: Windows 10, 6 GB RAM minimum, 8 GB recommended, with integrated graphics supported.

highlights.label: macOS
highlights.detail: OS X El Capitan 10.11 or newer, Apple silicon class processor, and 3 GB RAM.

highlights.label: Linux
highlights.detail: SteamOS or Linux with a comparable AMD or Intel processor and 3 GB RAM.

highlights.label: Storage
highlights.detail: 3 GB available space on every platform; install on an SSD for faster scene transitions.

modules.name: Heartfall A Tale in Three Lives Content Warnings
modules.description: Review the teen rating, adjustable effects, and the story themes to consider before starting a route.

highlights.label: Teen
highlights.detail: The game is aimed at teen and older audiences and includes fantasy violence, blood, character death, trauma, injury, and suicide.

highlights.label: Toggle
highlights.detail: Sudden noises, flashing and bright colors, and swearing can be adjusted in the settings menu.

highlights.label: Access
highlights.detail: Subtitles, captions, camera comfort, keyboard-only play, and Xbox controller support are listed.

highlights.label: Deaths
highlights.detail: Character death and repeated resets are central to the three-life premise, so the warnings apply across routes.

faq.title: Heartfall A Tale in Three Lives FAQ
faq.description: Answers to common questions about Heartfall A Tale in Three Lives, from route structure and saves to platforms and content warnings.

items.question: What is Heartfall A Tale in Three Lives?
items.answer: Heartfall A Tale in Three Lives is a free, single-player visual novel RPG developed by Kazehita. It is inspired by the 3rd Life series, follows Grian on a mysterious island, and uses dialogue choices to open twelve numbered routes and multiple endings.

items.question: Do I need to play 3rd Life before Heartfall A Tale in Three Lives?
items.answer: No. The developers state that no prior knowledge of 3rd Life is required for Heartfall A Tale in Three Lives; familiarity with the cast adds context but not a gameplay requirement.

items.question: How many routes and endings does Heartfall A Tale in Three Lives have?
items.answer: Heartfall A Tale in Three Lives has twelve numbered routes from Route 0 through Route 11 and 36 Steam achievements. Route 8 alone contains five endings, so dedicated saves matter for completion.

items.question: Does Heartfall A Tale in Three Lives support multiple saves?
items.answer: Yes. Heartfall A Tale in Three Lives uses isolated save files, and route gates happen early enough that separate slots for Session 1 and each ending setup are the safest way to replay.

items.question: Where can I play Heartfall A Tale in Three Lives?
items.answer: Heartfall A Tale in Three Lives is free on Steam for Windows, macOS, and Linux. The store page lists a roughly 3 GB install and English-only interface and subtitle support.

items.question: Is Heartfall A Tale in Three Lives suitable for younger teens?
items.answer: Heartfall A Tale in Three Lives is rated teen and older. The game includes toggleable flashing, sudden noises, and swearing, plus warnings for fantasy violence, blood, character death, trauma, injury, and suicide.
